3. Slide number: yellow (#ffff00) circle in the top right corner containing the number '12' in black text.
4. Definition box (upper left): gray rectangle (suggested fill #e0e0e0, slightly darker than background) with a red (#ff0000) underline along its bottom edge; inside, two black text lines: 'Correctly Classified (as Positive)' and 'Total objects that should be retrieved (Actually Positive)'.

Meaning section (middle left, directly below the definition box): header 'Meaning' in red #d00000 (inferred - see validation); below it the question 'Does the classified miss any of Positive Objects ?' in black, with the word 'miss' in red #ff0000 and the word 'Positive' underlined in blue #0000ff.

8. Curly brace: green (#008000) curly brace directly beneath and spanning both speech bubbles, with the black label 'All Positive Samples in the Dataset'.

11. Confusion matrix 1 (top right): header 'Predicted as' centered above a 2x2 grid; column headers 'P' and 'N'; row header 'Actual' to the left with row labels 'P' (top) and 'N' (bottom). Cells: (row P, col P) = 'TP' on green #00ff00; (row P, col N) = 'FN' on red #ff0000; (row N, col P) = 'FP' on red #ff0000; (row N, col N) = 'TN' on green #00ff00; all cell text black.

Negative tree (bottom right area, right of the two trees): label 'Negative' in red #d00000 (inferred); small line-drawing airplane icon at the top; root node = green (#00ff00) circle '70'; left child = green (#00ff00) circle '0' with black label 'TN' below; right child = red (#ff0000) circle '70' with black label 'FP' below; black connectors.
